'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Jarad Konsker DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jarad Konsker]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jarad
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
